title: Acme Finance - Private Deployment weekly sync (VPC/on-prem)
content:
Meeting: Acme Finance private deployment weekly sync (VPC/on-prem)
Date: 2026-03-02
Owner/notes: Jordan Smith (working notes + action tracker)
Attendees: Jordan Smith, Priya Patel, Marco Ruiz, Ben Carter, Elena Gomez, Sara Liu (Acme)

Agenda:
- Quick status (what shipped since last week)
- Milestones: VPC peering, KMS/HSM integration, DB replication, HA rollout, final acceptance tests
- Current blockers and escalation needs
- Action items and owners (with due dates)
- Next steps / next sync date

Summary of progress since last week:
- VPC peering: Completed preliminary peering between Redwood VPC and Acme dev VPC (peer established but routes not propagated to prod subnets).
- Bastion & jump host: Bastion AMI built and golden image approved by Acme security (image tag: acme-bastion-2026-02-25).
- KMS key: Customer provided KMS key metadata; initial integration tested in staging, encryption-at-rest flows passed for small payloads.
- DB replication: Initial logical replication set up between Acme Postgres primary and read replica in on-prem test cluster, but replication lag observed under load.
- Observability: Traces and metrics forwarding validated to Acme Splunk instance for a subset of services.

Milestones / status (RAG):
- VPC peering & route propagation: Amber (peer active, route propagation pending customer netops)
- Firewall and egress rules: Red (customer blocking outbound to telemetry endpoints; blocking tests for image downloads)
- KMS/HSM integration: Amber (key exists, IAM mapping pending final role policy)
- DB replication and failover: Amber/Red (replication established, performance concerns need root cause)
- HA cluster rollout (canary): Green for config, blocked by replication/perf for full rollout
- Final acceptance tests: Blocked until firewall & replication issues resolved

Blockers (with detail & owners):
- Customer firewall blocking outbound connections to Redwood telemetry and model artifact buckets (blocks image pulls and some telemetry). Owner: Sara Liu (Acme) / Escalation: Marco Ruiz to provide firewall rule template. Due: 2026-03-05
- Route propagation to prod subnets not configured on Acme side — results in some control-plane traffic failing. Owner: Acme netops (Sara) / Redwood owner: Priya Patel to coordinate BGP/route verification. Due: 2026-03-04
- Postgres replication lag under write-heavy load — initial hypothesis: disk IO on on-prem replica. Owner: Ben Carter (SRE) to run fio and iostat, collect disk metrics. Due: 2026-03-03 (blocking acceptance tests)
- IAM role for KMS key: missing trust policy allowing Redwood deployment account to encrypt/decrypt. Owner: Marco Ruiz (solutions eng) to draft policy + request, Sara to apply. Due: 2026-03-04
- Certificate chain for internal TLS: Acme using internal CA with cross-signed certs; some clients rejecting chain. Owner: Elena Gomez to coordinate with Acme PKI team; provide example certs. Due: 2026-03-06

Decisions made during sync:
- Proceed with canary HA rollout to dev cluster once replication lag issue is mitigated (no full prod rollout until acceptance tests green).
- Redwood will provide a minimal firewall/routing config bundle (JSON + iptables examples) to accelerate customer changes. Marco to attach to Slack thread.

Open questions / unresolved items:
- Can Acme temporarily allow outbound to telemetry endpoints from the bastion-only CIDR for initial rollout? (Sara to confirm)
- Is there an ops window next week for re-running replication tests with increased io capacity? (Sara/Acme to propose windows)
- Any compliance paperwork outstanding for on-prem encryption keys? (Jordan to confirm with compliance team)

Action items (explicit list):
1) Marco Ruiz: Create and share firewall rule template + iptables examples in Slack (#acme-onprem). Attach to PD-412. Due 2026-03-03. Status: in_progress.
2) Priya Patel: Run BGP/route validation with Acme netops; confirm route propagation and provide packet-capture checklist. Due 2026-03-04. Status: assigned.
3) Ben Carter: Run fio/iostat on on-prem replica, capture disk throughput/latency, attach logs to JIRA PD-412. Due 2026-03-03. Status: assigned.
4) Marco Ruiz + Sara Liu: Apply KMS trust policy change (Marco drafts, Sara applies). Marco to post draft to Confluence page. Due 2026-03-04. Status: open.
5) Elena Gomez: Provide sample cert chain and troubleshooting steps; schedule short call with Acme PKI. Due 2026-03-06. Status: open.
6) Jordan Smith: Confirm with Redwood compliance whether any further paperwork required for customer KMS/HSM usage; escalate if needed. Due 2026-03-05. Status: open.
7) Sara Liu (Acme): Confirm temporary outbound allowance for telemetry from bastion CIDR or propose alternative. Due 2026-03-03. Status: pending.

Risks / notes for sales/CS: 
- If firewall/route issues persist > 1 week, timeline for production rollout will slip by 2+ weeks. Recommend CS alert AE and set expectation with Acme leadership.
- Replication performance could require hardware tuning (IO or networking) on Acme side — might trigger a change order for increased ops support.

Next steps for the team:
- Focus this week on removing immediate blockers: firewall rules, route propagation, disk perf. Prioritize tests that unblock acceptance.
- Keep PRD acceptance checklist (Confluence) updated with pass/fail for each test case.
- Jordan to run quick daily standups (10-min) MWF optionally until blockers cleared.

Next sync: Proposed 2026-03-09 (weekly). If major blockers resolved earlier, opt for ad-hoc wrap-up call.

Notes / scratchpad items (things to remember):
- Draft escalation email template for AE in case timeline slips (put in shared_drive later).
- Double-check customer CIDR ranges vs. route tables (we saw mismatch in last run).
- Add fio run config to PD-412 so Ben's runs are reproducible.

End of notes.
